sections.title: P10.3 focused self-check
sections.text:
Executor self-check; no independent item review verdict is claimed. D81 and the owner's instruction waive the large item review; whole-phase review remains assigned to P10.4.

- The worker emits and flushes ready after autoload and adapter initialization, before reading stdin. Admission and validation use the same protocol. Readiness parsing preserves partial frames and any response bytes after the ready newline.
- Startup has an internal 5000 ms default and optional Internal constructor override for fixtures. The 100 ms validation deadline starts before encoding/writing stdin; every loop and decoded response checks a monotonic clock. All streams are nonblocking; input backpressure consumes this budget.
- Before ready, timeout, EOF and malformed framing reject with schema_unavailable; afterwards transport, deadline, memory, nonzero exit, JSON and result shape failures reject with schema_limit. Only explicit boolean ok plus typed handle/validation can produce a result. GuardedToolInvoker already maps both codes on input and output.
- Finally always calls cleanup. It sends terminate, waits at most 50 ms while draining output, force kills a live worker, closes only retained pipes and reaps via proc_close. PID assertions on fixtures verify no surviving or zombie process; no proc_get_status is called on a closed process resource.
- Stderr is drained in 64 KiB chunks and discarded (zero retained bytes). Response buffering is bounded by the unchanged worker memory ceiling. Success, partial/coalesced framing, stderr saturation, missing readiness, validation timeout, allocation failure, blocked stdin and SIGTERM resistance have behavior tests.
- SchemaProfile is unchanged at 100 ms / 64 MiB. Public php-api manifests are unchanged. D83 permits exactly the already-declared Internal startupMs constructor parameter in Golden; semantic removal of that one parameter reconstructs the complete original snapshot. Routes/events/wire stay byte-identical; no GOLDEN_UPDATE or scanner suppression is used. Seven resolved tools PHPStan baseline entries removed (10 errors); no baseline additions or threshold changes.
- First product candidate c4e48b69 omitted REBASELINE.md metadata; immediate corrective commit 699310df adds the D83 entry. Final candidate's Golden and anti-weakening hosted jobs are GREEN. This procedural mistake is recorded, without claiming the initial gate passed.

Hosted run 36911849175 exposed an expected missing-executable proc_open warning that Pest 4/5 can observe despite @. The final repair converts E_WARNING only around proc_open to schema_unavailable and restores the previous handler in finally. The existing missing-executable test installs a strict outer handler to prove no warning escapes; all 21 fixture scenarios still pass. This is an in-scope fail-closed startup repair; no test warning suppression or PHPUnit setting is changed.
